swus.objective: Approve the exact ordered Body War entry context profile and mapping evidence.
swus.primary_behavior: one owner decision closes OD-01
swus.independent_acceptance: exact IDs, order, purpose and evidence selectors validate without inferring membership
swus.split_analysis: Ordering and mapping evidence are one executable Home profile; Path and count policies are separate units.
swus.validation_surface: manual owner review plus jq and source-ID existence check
swus.result_shape: decision id, selected values, rejected alternatives, rationale and profile digest

swus.objective: Select comparator or route-local Path presentation.
swus.primary_behavior: one owner decision closes OD-02
swus.independent_acceptance: one allowed literal and rationale preserve complete hop semantics
swus.split_analysis: The single policy field is atomic; derivation and UI remain separate units.
done_criteria: OD-02 is exactly one allowed value
swus.validation_surface: allowed-value and owner-signature review
swus.result_shape: decision id, selected value, rejected alternative and rationale

swus.objective: Select hide, disable or retain for zero-count projection values.
swus.primary_behavior: one owner decision closes OD-03
swus.independent_acceptance: one allowed literal includes a non-color state rule
swus.split_analysis: The policy is one atomic field; UI copy and behavior remain SWU-016.
swus.validation_surface: allowed-value and projection-count ceiling review
swus.result_shape: decision id, selected value and rationale

swus.objective: Derive one versioned lossless relation presentation record from an admitted edge and sidecar.
swus.primary_behavior: exact edge becomes one canonical complete presentation record
swus.independent_acceptance: positive and negative pure fixtures pass with no visible UI change
swus.split_analysis: Schema, mapping and canonicalization have no separately usable outcome; together they are the smallest renderer input.
done_criteria: all required identities/directions/evidence/authority fields are exact
predicate color and presentation pattern mappings fail closed
legacy base build identity and patch inventory remain byte-exact
semantic build handle records seven typed tests and the exact dedicated binding
acceptance_evidence: dedicated semantic-navigation binding and build-handle digests
swus.validation_surface: focused typed tests, build-semantic-navigation, legacy build compatibility, historical input hashes, patch inventory, JSON contracts and scoped diff checks
swus.result_shape: Task Session receipt with five material files, semantic build handle, dashboard dist, typed fixture results, historical equality and residue

resolved_blockers.resolution: Decision Gate option 2 assigns additive semantic-navigation inputs and outputs to a dedicated binding while historical base identities remain read-only

swus.objective: Render exact redundant relation semantics in one selected-edge scene.
swus.primary_behavior: selected relation remains identifiable without color
swus.independent_acceptance: exact fields and default/grayscale/forced-color/contrast witness pass
swus.split_analysis: Visual fields and redundant encoding form one semantic renderer; keyboard interaction is separate SWU-006.
swus.validation_surface: focused typed tests and selected-edge Chromium color-mode matrix

swus.objective: Make edge focus and activation role-sensitive.
swus.primary_behavior: only actionable relation instances enter focus and activate
swus.independent_acceptance: inert tab count zero and actionable Enter/Space round trip pass
swus.split_analysis: Focus membership and activation close one operable behavior; visual semantics already pass in SWU-005.
done_criteria: visible focus and exact accessible identity
swus.validation_surface: focused navigation tests and keyboard-only Chromium assertion

swus.objective: Derive the owner-approved Body War Home projection.
swus.primary_behavior: approved profile yields ordered bounded Home model
swus.independent_acceptance: pure fixture contains only approved contexts, projection counts, provenance and all-loaded escape
swus.split_analysis: ID admission and ordered projection are one read model; transitions and card rendering are separate.
swus.validation_surface: focused pure tests and profile schema/source-ID validation

swus.objective: Implement portal, Back and all-loaded transitions with exact restoration.
swus.primary_behavior: one navigation round trip restores the prior frame
swus.independent_acceptance: scope/filter/selection/direction/viewport/focus ledger passes
swus.split_analysis: Transition and restoration are one reversible state behavior; card semantics are separate SWU-009.
swus.validation_surface: navigation/responsive tests and portal/Back/show-all Chromium matrix

swus.objective: Render profile-owned cluster cards with redundant icons, text, counts and evidence.
swus.primary_behavior: one card communicates scope and entrance without icon/color dependence
swus.independent_acceptance: card DOM/accessibility/screenshot contract passes
swus.split_analysis: Purpose, icon/text, count and entrance evidence are one card record; transition state is separate.
swus.validation_surface: focused card tests and screenshot-review checklist

swus.objective: Derive deterministic complete Path alternatives under the approved policy.
swus.primary_behavior: Path query returns ordered complete hop records
swus.independent_acceptance: forward, reverse, not-found and stale pure fixtures pass
swus.split_analysis: Search and hop projection must close together; UI and recovery are separate.
swus.validation_surface: focused pure Path tests

swus.objective: Render the Path surface and complete its focus/recovery cycle.
swus.primary_behavior: named Path surface presents complete route and restores invoker
swus.independent_acceptance: activation, result, cancel, dismissal and restoration pass desktop/narrow keyboard runs
swus.split_analysis: Surface state and recovery are one interaction cycle; algorithm truth already closes in SWU-010.
swus.validation_surface: focused UI tests and Path browser matrix

swus.objective: Correct startup modal initial focus and dismissal restoration.
swus.primary_behavior: startup modal owns focus then returns it to graph entry
swus.independent_acceptance: initial and every dismissal path have visible exact focus
swus.split_analysis: Entry and dismissal are one modal lifecycle; modes and disclosures are independent.
done_criteria: focus never remains on body while modal active
swus.validation_surface: navigation tests and pointer/keyboard desktop/narrow modal matrix

swus.objective: Expose one selected mode and its distinctly named result region.
swus.primary_behavior: mode selection and result ownership are programmatic and visible
swus.independent_acceptance: exactly one selected state and matching named region pass
swus.split_analysis: Selection and owned result must close together; meaningful distinction stays human study.
swus.validation_surface: focused mode tests and browser assertions

swus.objective: Give Filter pattern-appropriate owned state and focus restoration.
swus.primary_behavior: the Filter disclosure owns one labeled surface and restores its trigger
swus.independent_acceptance: Filter activation, result, dismissal and restoration pass independently
swus.split_analysis: Filter has its own result state and trigger lifecycle; Export is independently acceptable in SWU-OEWSN-019.
swus.validation_surface: focused tests and disclosure browser matrix

swus.objective: Repair named text, boundary, focus and relation contrast tokens.
swus.primary_behavior: named applicable states meet exact contrast thresholds
swus.independent_acceptance: ratio ledger records role/state/colors/runtime and every required threshold passes
swus.split_analysis: Token changes and measurement form one visual contract; semantic copy remains separate.
swus.validation_surface: browser measurement script and forced-color assertions

swus.objective: Correct freshness, artifact identity, provenance and authority-ceiling copy.
swus.primary_behavior: the trust and onboarding copy is literal, actionable and non-authoritative
swus.independent_acceptance: the dead action is absent and the required artifact, provenance and authority literals pass
swus.split_analysis: Trust and artifact identity form one explanatory boundary; projection counts and zero-policy behavior are independently acceptable in SWU-OEWSN-020.
done_criteria: candidate-local artifact and qualified provenance/ceiling present
acceptance_evidence: literal trust and onboarding DOM receipt
swus.validation_surface: focused trust/copy tests and browser literal assertions

swus.objective: Run every frozen Body War task, control, state, mode and relation cell against the current build.
swus.primary_behavior: one bound browser run emits complete current evidence or explicit residue
swus.independent_acceptance: coverage manifest has no missing required cell and all runtime/teardown bindings validate
swus.split_analysis: Individual probes do not form comparable evidence without one run manifest; delta comparison is separate.
acceptance_evidence: coverage, DOM, accessibility, contrast, keyboard, request, console and teardown ledgers
swus.validation_surface: runner self-tests and complete browser evidence matrix

swus.objective: Produce and independently validate the frozen baseline-to-current atomic delta receipt.
swus.primary_behavior: stable claim IDs map to exact deltas/residue under unchanged classes and ceilings
swus.independent_acceptance: positive and tampered receipt fixtures prove producer/verifier contract
swus.split_analysis: Delta production and independent validation form one acceptance receipt; current evidence is already closed.
done_criteria: every stable claim has one allowed delta/residue
swus.validation_surface: delta unit tests plus independent verifier

swus.objective: Give Export pattern-appropriate owned state and focus restoration.
swus.primary_behavior: the Export disclosure owns one labeled result surface and restores its trigger
swus.independent_acceptance: Export activation, result or error, dismissal and restoration pass independently
swus.split_analysis: Export has its own result/error state and trigger lifecycle; Filter closes separately in SWU-OEWSN-014.
swus.validation_surface: focused Export tests and disclosure browser matrix

swus.objective: Label projection counts and apply the approved zero-count policy.
swus.primary_behavior: Filter counts and absent values reflect only the current projection under OD-03
swus.independent_acceptance: projection wording and the selected hide, disable or retain behavior pass without color dependence
swus.split_analysis: Count scope and zero-value handling are one Filter data-state contract; trust and artifact copy close separately in SWU-OEWSN-016.
done_criteria: OD-03 behavior is exact and non-color-dependent
swus.validation_surface: focused Filter/profile tests and browser count/state assertions

swus.objective: Approve one versioned Body War relation-encoding profile.
swus.primary_behavior: one joint owner decision closes OD-04
swus.independent_acceptance: every admitted exact predicate maps to one stable color token and every presentation relation maps to one stable pattern token with non-color recovery
swus.split_analysis: Color and pattern rows form one renderer input contract; relation derivation cannot be accepted with either half missing.
done_criteria: all current sidecar predicates and presentation relations are covered
exact tokens, fallbacks and redundant text rules are digest-bound
acceptance_evidence: profile digest and sidecar coverage validation
swus.validation_surface: manual joint-owner review plus mapping coverage, contrast preflight and JSON validation
swus.result_shape: decision id, versioned mapping tables, owner approvals, rationale and profile digest
